title: Abersoch to Llanbedrog Tin Man Walk Route

images.title: The Tin Man overlooking Llanbedrog Beach by Eirian Evans, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: The Tin Man overlooking Llanbedrog Beach

description: This walk follows a lovely section of the Wales Coast Path from Abersoch to Llanbedrog. The route runs along a signposted path for a distance of about 4 miles. You'll pass along Abersoch's beautiful beaches before a cliff top hike to Trwyn Llanbedrog (Llanbedrog Headland). The path climbs gently to the top, where you'll find the iconic Tin Man sculpture and a viewpoint offering panoramic vistas. Descending from the headland, the path leads into the charming village of Llanbedrog, known for its sheltered sandy beach, colorful beach huts, and the Plas Glyn-y-Weddw art gallery and gardens.
